before.workingTree: Preserved existing main dirty edits; no branch/reset/merge/stash was performed by this agent.
before.claimProtocol: Three separate claim/checkpoint/expiry/insert paths and direct work-store private infrastructure access.
before.telegram: Generic delivery adapter directly resolved Telegram recipients, bindings and receipts.
before.errorHandling: Several authority/status/context exceptions were silently skipped.

after.claimProtocol: One _claim_authorized protocol serializes scoped advisory lock + checkpoint FOR UPDATE + terminal expiry/ambiguity + current-authority equality + initial claim insert.
after.selection: Existing summary/explicit artifact/document selection predicates retained; rejected summaries skipped per sweep rather than terminating unrelated selection.
after.transactionFailure: Root transaction rollback before logging/skip. No savepoints: existing timeline and scope contracts explicitly require a root transaction.
after.authority: Summary now checks current owner and channel authority before claiming and rechecks inside same root transaction; worker retains immediate pre-send and per-part checks.
after.storeBoundary: delivery_transaction enforces fixed role/scope; validate_delivery_authority and load_delivery_work reuse existing owner locks and result decoding; public engine only composes trusted peer PostgreSQL adapters.
after.telegram: TelegramDeliveryAuthority injected only by bootstrap composition and tests; generic adapter has no Telegram imports or recipient/binding/receipt logic.
after.privacy: Rejected candidate log contains fixed stage, SHA256 of work identity and exception class; no exception message/traceback, owner/chat IDs, source content or credentials.
after.immutableEvidence: Spec/source hashes, original routes, summary and explicit-artifact operation identities, acknowledgements and terminal uncertain claims are retained.

tests.environment: Pinned existing Python gate environment; isolated tmpfs PostgreSQL16.13 containers network=none; fresh disposable database for each module; no live DSN/models/provider calls.
fixtureCorrections: Shared fixture expected current schema4e_0012_conversation_source_lock rather than obsolete4e_0009; logger state restored after Alembic fileConfig.
Ancestry test double now implements public load_delivery_work; digital-return fixture admits exact ingress required by existing retained_source_guard.
Document fixture uses real telegram:<chat>:<numeric-message> identity and current transport reply_to_message_id argument; asserts original saved title/content rather than obsolete report envelope.
Explicit TelegramAuthority composition replaces old bindings_loader construction in all known callsites/tests.

adjacentKnownFailure.reason: Existing dashboard route intentionally returns the same unacknowledged result; older test expects exactly one concurrent poll result. Voice remains single claim. No production change or criterion weakening was made.

deploymentBoundary: delegated_work.py participates in the digital execution source profile: parent must overlay exact reviewed changes on current installed images and match core+worker profiles before deployment. No full dirty-tree build.
reviewLimitations: External Telegram acceptance cannot be made transactionally exactly-once: uncertain attempts stay permanently ambiguous and are never automatically replayed.

PostgreSQL deadlock/serialization failures propagate fail-closed; no external dispatch occurs before durable claim commit. No broader lock-order refactor was attempted without a concrete reproduction.
A 16-candidate per-call summary sweep remains bounded as before; this evidence proves skip of one rejected candidate and later eligible work, not unbounded scheduling fairness.
